title: LLM-based Relevance Assessment Still Can't Replace Human Relevance Assessment

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating circular evaluation by using the UMBRELA LLM as a final-stage re-ranker for TREC RAG 24 submissions, and then comparing the evaluation rankings (Kendall's tau) and scores (NDCG) produced by the same LLM against human relevance judgments. This demonstrates an artificial score inflation where the LLM disproportionately favors ranking systems that incorporate its own or similar LLM outputs.
